fundingAgency.name: Ministry of the Environment of the Czech Republic

general.abstract: A unique mosaic of ecosystems of topmost summits (lichen tundra), grasslands and peat bogs of the summit plateaux (grassy tundra) and leeward slopes of glacial cirques of the Krkonose/Giant Mts (flower-rich tundra). It represents an unusual combination of Nordic, Central European and alpine organisms and their communities. It covers an area of 47 km2, i.e. 7.4% out of the whole area of the Krkonose/Giant Mts (32 km2 in the Czech part and 15 km2 in the Polish part of the Krkonose/Giant Mts).

landUse.label: natural areas not in other economic use

eunisHabitat.label: Grasslands and lands dominated by forbs, mosses or lichens (E)

environmentalCharacteristics.hydrology: spring areas, creeks, small bog lakes
environmentalCharacteristics.vegetation: tall-herb and shrubby vegetation in glacial corries (´flower-rich tundra´, incl. Pinus mugo, Sorbus sp. and Salix sp.); subalpine and alpine grasslands with scattered stands of Pinus mugo, and peat bog communities on ridge plateaux (´grassy tundra´); moss and lichen communities on topmost summits (´lichen tundra´)

observations.scale: plot without link to explicit catchment

infrastructure.notes: There are several mountain challets (offering accommodation, food etc.) available in the site.
